features.name: day_progress_norm
features.description: Maps day to a bounded yearly progress coordinate using the observed 1 to 365 span.
features.expected_model_benefit: Allows a linear SVM to use monotonic calendar drift as a smooth margin direction.

features.name: length_log_norm
features.description: Log-normalized chain length relative to the observed maximum length of 144.
features.expected_model_benefit: Turns a heavy-tailed depth measure into a bounded near-linear input.

features.name: weight_log_norm
features.description: Log-normalized transfer weight relative to the observed maximum weight.
features.expected_model_benefit: Compresses extreme skew in weight so unusually large values influence the margin without dominating it.

features.name: count_log_norm
features.description: Log-normalized activity count using the observed count range from 1 to 13334.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a smooth activity-volume coordinate for linear margin fitting.

features.name: neighbors_log_norm
features.description: Log-normalized neighbor breadth using the observed neighbor range from 1 to 824.
features.expected_model_benefit: Exposes address breadth on a scale where large hubs remain usable by a linear SVM.

features.name: income_log_norm
features.description: Log-normalized income using the observed income range from 30000000 to 1544509020257.
features.expected_model_benefit: Gives a bounded monetary-scale direction while reducing the influence of extreme income values.

features.name: loop_reuse_share
features.description: Bounded share of looped activity within total observed activity, with smoothing for small counts.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures reuse intensity with a stable ratio that is less sensitive to raw count scale.

features.name: neighbor_activity_balance
features.description: Bounded ratio of neighbor breadth to combined event volume and neighbor breadth.
features.expected_model_benefit: Represents whether activity is broad relative to event volume, adding a smooth sparsity and concentration direction.

features.name: income_per_activity_log_norm
features.description: Log-normalized income per activity unit, using count smoothing for stability.
features.expected_model_benefit: Helps identify rows where monetary magnitude is high relative to event volume while staying smooth for margin learning.

features.name: flow_volume_structure_index
features.description: Hand-weighted bounded index combining monetary size, event volume, path depth, loop reuse, weight, and neighbor breadth.
features.expected_model_benefit: Supplies an interpretable linear projection across several row-level cues, matching SVM margin geometry.

features.name: semantic_structure_complexity_score
features.description: Numeric semantic score in [0.0, 1.0] assigned from row fields and fixed training-fold ranges: 0.0 for simple, short, low-volume, low-reuse, narrow-neighbor patterns; 1.0 for long, high-volume, high-reuse, broad-neighbor patterns; intermediate values should vary smoothly with the evidence.
features.expected_model_benefit: Condenses several row-level structural cues into a single ordinal severity feature that can be used directly by a linear margin.

features.name: semantic_flow_concentration_score
features.description: Numeric semantic score in [0.0, 1.0] assigned from row fields and fixed training-fold ranges: 0.0 for diffuse flow with income spread over many events and little looping; 1.0 for concentrated flow with large income relative to activity scale or pronounced looping; intermediate values reflect partial concentration.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds a human-readable concentration cue that complements deterministic ratios when boundary behavior is approximately linear but not captured by one formula.
